issues.message: C4 requires a fresh authoritative accumulator version and explicitly sends a missing version to review. Positive initial-analysis fixtures EV1, EV4, EV9, EV30 omit accumulatorVersion and freshness from policy/snapshot/registry mock, while expecting authoritative amounts and successful drafts. Version 7 appears only in their preconstructed output operation assessment, which cannot prove the source input is fresh. EV23 supplies the version but no explicit freshness basis. Add a typed authoritative accumulator snapshot/version/freshness contract and fixture input, then a missing/stale negative case; propagate through eval-set and build milestones. Do not obtain trusted source provenance by copying the expected output payload backwards.

The concurrency fixture starts operations OP-A and OP-B, but its only immutable authorized operation payload/hash is for OP-1. Under C7 exact operation/resource binding, neither competitor has a complete valid authorized payload; expected one successful CAS write therefore cannot isolate concurrency. Supply two fully materialized independently authorized payloads/hashes with matching operation IDs and expectedVersion 3; assert the losing CAS outcome and absence of overwrite.
